for pages that don't have the preconnect. */\n@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap');\n\n:root {\n /* Brand palette */\n --navy-900: #0b1629;\n --navy-800: #111d35;\n --navy-700: #172644;\n --navy-600: #1e3a5f;\n --accent-blue: #3b82f6;\n --accent-indigo: #6366f1;\n\n /* Severity */\n --sev-critical: #ef4444;\n --sev-high: #f97316;\n --sev-medium: #eab308;\n --sev-low: #22c55e;\n --sev-info: #3b82f6;\n\n /* Grade colors */\n --grade-a: #22c55e;\n --grade-b: #84cc16;\n --grade-c: #eab308;\n --grade-d: #f97316;\n --grade-f: #ef4444;\n}\n\n/* ---------- Base ---------- */\nhtml {\n scroll-behavior: smooth;\n}\n\nbody {\n font-family: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;\n background: #f8fafc;\n color: #1e293b;\n -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;\n -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;\n /* Prevent horizontal overflow from any child */\n overflow-x: hidden;\n}\n\n/* ---------- Scroll margin for fixed header ---------- */\n[id^=\"section-\"] {\n scroll-margin-top: 5rem; /* 80px = 64px nav + 16px breathing room */\n}\n\n/* ---------- Grade badge ---------- */\n.grade-badge {\n display: inline-flex;\n align-items: center;\n justify-content: center;\n width: 120px;\n height: 120px;\n border-radius: 50%;\n font-size: 3rem;\n font-weight: 800;\n line-height: 1;\n color: #fff;\n position: relative;\n box-shadow:\n 0 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.15),\n 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);\n}\n\n.grade-badge::after {\n content: '';\n position: absolute;\n inset: -8px;\n border-radius: 50%;\n border: 2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.2);\n}\n\n.grade-badge.grade-a { background: var(--grade-a); }\n.grade-badge.grade-b { background: var(--grade-b); }\n.grade-badge.grade-c { background: var(--grade-c); }\n.grade-badge.grade-d { background: var(--grade-d); }\n.grade-badge.grade-f { background: var(--grade-f); }\n\n/* ---------- Severity badges ---------- */\n.severity-badge {\n display: inline-flex;\n align-items: center;\n padding: 2px 10px;\n border-radius: 9999px;\n font-size: 0.75rem; /* Bumped from 0.7rem (11.2px) to 0.75rem (12px) for mobile readability */\n font-weight: 600;\n text-transform: uppercase;\n letter-spacing: 0.05em;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.severity-badge.critical,\n.severity-badge.very-high { background: #fef2f2; color: #dc2626; border: 1px solid #fecaca; }\n.severity-badge.high { background: #fff7ed; color: #ea580c; border: 1px solid #fed7aa; }\n.severity-badge.medium { background: #fefce8; color: #ca8a04; border: 1px solid #fef08a; }\n.severity-badge.low { background: #f0fdf4; color: #16a34a; border: 1px solid #bbf7d0; }\n.severity-badge.info { background: #eff6ff; color: #2563eb; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe; }\n\n/* ---------- Impact / Effort pills ---------- */\n.pill {\n display: inline-flex;\n align-items: center;\n gap: 4px;\n padding: 3px 10px;\n border-radius: 9999px;\n font-size: 0.75rem; /* Bumped from 0.7rem to 0.75rem for readability */\n font-weight: 600;\n letter-spacing: 0.03em;\n}\n\n.pill-impact-high,\n.pill-impact-very-high { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; }\n.pill-impact-medium { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; }\n.pill-impact-low { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; }\n\n.pill-effort-low { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; }\n.pill-effort-medium,\n.pill-effort-medium-high { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; }\n.pill-effort-high { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; }\n\n/* ---------- Core Web Vitals gauge ---------- */\n.cwv-gauge {\n position: relative;\n width: 100%;\n height: 12px;\n border-radius: 6px;\n background: #e2e8f0;\n overflow: visible;\n}\n\n.cwv-gauge-fill {\n height: 100%;\n border-radius: 6px;\n transition: width 1s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);\n position: relative;\n}\n\n.cwv-gauge-fill.green { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #22c55e, #4ade80); }\n.cwv-gauge-fill.orange { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f97316, #fbbf24); }\n.cwv-gauge-fill.red { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ef4444, #f97316); }\n\n.cwv-gauge-marker {\n position: absolute;\n top: -4px;\n width: 4px;\n height: 20px;\n border-radius: 2px;\n background: #475569;\n opacity: 0.4;\n}\n\n/* ---------- Stat cards ---------- */\n.stat-card {\n background: #fff;\n border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n border-radius: 12px;\n padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.25rem) clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);\n transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;\n overflow: hidden;\n min-width: 0; /* Prevent grid blowout */\n}\n\n.stat-card:hover {\n box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);\n transform: translateY(-1px);\n}\n\n.stat-card .stat-value {\n font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);\n font-weight: 800;\n line-height: 1.1;\n overflow-wrap: break-word;\n word-break: break-word;\n hyphens: auto;\n}\n\n.stat-card .stat-label {\n font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 0.8rem);\n color: #64748b;\n margin-top: 0.35rem;\n line-height: 1.4;\n}\n\n.stat-card.severity-red .stat-value { color: var(--sev-critical); }\n.stat-card.severity-orange .stat-value { color: var(--sev-high); }\n.stat-card.severity-yellow .stat-value { color: var(--sev-medium); }\n.stat-card.severity-green .stat-value { color: var(--sev-low); }\n\n/* ---------- Section container ---------- */\n.report-section {\n max-width: 1200px;\n margin: 0 auto;\n padding: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3rem) clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);\n}\n\n.section-heading {\n font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);\n font-weight: 700;\n color: var(--navy-800);\n margin-bottom: 0.5rem;\n display: flex;\n align-items: center;\n gap: 0.5rem;\n}\n\n.section-heading .section-number {\n display: inline-flex;\n align-items: center;\n justify-content: center;\n width: 32px;\n height: 32px;\n border-radius: 8px;\n background: var(--navy-800);\n color: #fff;\n font-size: 0.85rem;\n font-weight: 700;\n flex-shrink: 0;\n}\n\n.section-sub {\n font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 0.9rem);\n color: #64748b;\n margin-bottom: 1.5rem;\n}\n\n/* ---------- Tables ---------- */\n.report-table-wrap {\n overflow-x: auto;\n -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;\n border-radius: 12px;\n border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n background: #fff;\n}\n\n.report-table {\n width: 100%;\n border-collapse: collapse;\n font-size: 0.875rem;\n}\n\n.report-table thead th {\n background: #f8fafc;\n padding: 0.75rem 1rem;\n text-align: left;\n font-weight: 600;\n color: #475569;\n border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.report-table tbody td {\n padding: 0.7rem 1rem;\n border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;\n vertical-align: top;\n overflow-wrap: break-word;\n word-break: break-word;\n}\n\n.report-table tbody tr:last-child td {\n border-bottom: none;\n}\n\n.report-table tbody tr:hover {\n background: #f8fafc;\n}\n\n.report-table .highlight-col {\n background: #eff6ff;\n font-weight: 600;\n}\n\n/* ---------- Issue cards ---------- */\n.issue-card {\n background: #fff;\n border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n border-radius: 12px;\n padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;\n display: flex;\n gap: 1rem;\n align-items: flex-start;\n transition: box-shadow 0.2s;\n min-width: 0; /* Prevent flex blowout */\n}\n\n.issue-card:hover {\n box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);\n}\n\n.issue-number {\n display: flex;\n align-items: center;\n justify-content: center;\n min-width: 36px;\n height: 36px;\n border-radius: 50%;\n background: var(--navy-800);\n color: #fff;\n font-weight: 700;\n font-size: 0.9rem;\n flex-shrink: 0;\n}\n\n/* ---------- Advantage cards ---------- */\n.advantage-card {\n background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0fdf4, #ecfdf5);\n border: 1px solid #bbf7d0;\n border-radius: 12px;\n padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;\n}\n\n.advantage-card .adv-title {\n font-weight: 700;\n color: #166534;\n margin-bottom: 0.25rem;\n}\n\n.advantage-card .adv-detail {\n font-size: 0.875rem;\n color: #15803d;\n}\n\n/* ---------- Chart containers ---------- */\n.chart-container {\n position: relative;\n background: #fff;\n border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n border-radius: 12px;\n padding: 1.5rem;\n}\n\n.chart-container canvas {\n max-height: 350px;\n}\n\n/* ---------- Action plan tabs ---------- */\n.tab-btn {\n padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem;\n border-radius: 9999px;\n font-size: 0.85rem;\n font-weight: 600;\n cursor: pointer;\n border: 2px solid transparent;\n background: #f1f5f9;\n color: #475569;\n transition: all 0.15s;\n /* Ensure touch target */\n min-height: 44px;\n display: inline-flex;\n align-items: center;\n}\n\n.tab-btn:hover {\n background: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n.tab-btn.active {\n background: var(--navy-800);\n color: #fff;\n border-color: var(--navy-800);\n}\n\n.tab-panel {\n display: none;\n}\n\n.tab-panel.active {\n display: block;\n}\n\n/* ---------- Collapsible ---------- */\n.collapsible-header {\n cursor: pointer;\n user-select: none;\n display: flex;\n align-items: center;\n justify-content: space-between;\n padding: 1rem 1.5rem;\n background: #f8fafc;\n border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n border-radius: 12px;\n font-weight: 600;\n transition: background 0.15s;\n /* Ensure touch target */\n min-height: 48px;\n}\n\n.collapsible-header:hover {\n background: #f1f5f9;\n}\n\n.collapsible-header .chevron {\n transition: transform 0.2s;\n}\n\n.collapsible-header.open .chevron {\n transform: rotate(180deg);\n}\n\n.collapsible-body {\n max-height: 0;\n overflow: hidden;\n transition: max-height 0.3s ease;\n}\n\n.collapsible-body.open {\n max-height: 5000px;\n}\n\n/* ---------- Hero section ---------- */\n.hero-section {\n background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-900) 0%, var(--navy-700) 50%, var(--navy-600) 100%);\n color: #fff;\n position: relative;\n overflow: hidden;\n}\n\n.hero-section::before {\n content: '';\n position: absolute;\n top: -50%;\n right: -20%;\n width: 60%;\n height: 200%;\n background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(99,102,241,0.08), transparent 70%);\n pointer-events: none;\n}\n\n.hero-section::after {\n content: '';\n position: absolute;\n bottom: 0;\n left: 0;\n right: 0;\n height: 1px;\n background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.1), transparent);\n}\n\n/* ---------- Quick-win checklist ---------- */\n.quickwin-item {\n display: flex;\n align-items: flex-start;\n gap: 0.75rem;\n padding: 0.85rem 1rem;\n border-radius: 8px;\n transition: background 0.15s;\n /* Ensure touch target height */\n min-height: 48px;\n}\n\n.quickwin-item:hover {\n background: #f8fafc;\n}\n\n.quickwin-check {\n ---------- Next step card ---------- */\n.nextstep-card {\n display: flex;\n gap: 1rem;\n align-items: flex-start;\n padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;\n background: #fff;\n border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n border-radius: 12px;\n min-width: 0; /* Prevent flex blowout */\n}\n\n.nextstep-number {\n display: flex;\n align-items: center;\n justify-content: center;\n min-width: 40px;\n height: 40px;\n Fade-in animation ---------- */\n@keyframes fadeInUp {\n from {\n opacity: 0;\n transform: translateY(20px);\n }\n to {\n opacity: 1;\n transform: translateY(0);\n }\n}\n\n.animate-in {\n animation: animation-delay: 0.35s; }\n.animate-in:nth-child(8) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }\n\n/* Reduce motion for users who prefer it */\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {\n .animate-in {\n animation: none;\n opacity: 1;\n }\n}\n\n/* ---------- Content calendar ---------- */\n.cal-month-header {\n font-size: 1.05rem;\n font-weight: 700;\n color: var(--navy-800);\n padding: 0.75rem 1rem;\n var(--grade-b); }\n.grade-badge.grade-c { background: var(--grade-c); }\n.grade-badge.grade-d { background: var(--grade-d); }\n.grade-badge.grade-f { background: var(--grade-f); }\n\n/* ---------- background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; }\n\n.pill-effort-low { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; }\n.pill-effort-medium,\n.pill-effort-medium-high { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; no intermediate breakpoint for tablet\n- `GRID_5COL_NO_INTERMEDIATE` (technical.js:863) -- `xl:grid-cols-5` same issue\n- `TABLE_NO_SCROLL_HINT` (report-styles.css) -- Tables have `overflow-x: auto` but no visual indicator that content scrolls\n- `NO_ARIA_ON_GAUGES` (charts.js:151-173) -- CWV gauge bars lack `role=\"meter\"` and ARIA attributes for screen readers\n- `DECORATIVE_SVG_NO_ARIA` (charts.js, technical.js) -- Decorative SVGs missing `aria-hidden=\"true\"`\n- `NO_320PX_BREAKPOINT` (report-styles.css) -- No styles for very small phones (320-360px); padding and font sizes could overflow\n\n### Low\n- `TAILWIND_CDN_PRODUCTION` (technical.html:8) -- Tailwind CDN (3.7MB raw) used in production; build process would reduce dramatically\n- `CHART_FONT_SIZE_MOBILE` (charts.js:28) -- Chart.js default 12px font size could be reduced on mobile for better fit\n- `CWV_GAUGE_PADDING_MOBILE` (charts.js:183,197) -- CWV gauge containers use `p-6` (24px) padding on all screens\n\n---\n\n## Changes Applied\n\n### technical.html\n\n| Change | Why |\n|---|---|\n| Added `maximum-scale=5.0` to viewport meta | WCAG compliance -- allows pinch zoom up to 5x |\n| Added 4 `` hints | Eliminates DNS + TLS negotiation latency for fonts.googleapis.com, fonts.gstatic.com, cdn.tailwindcss.com, cdn.jsdelivr.net |\n| Added `` for Google Fonts | Removes font from render-blocking @import chain; font loads in parallel with CSS |\n| Added `
